package lifecycle

// This file makes activation.signed.json of the koodam fixture set v0.7.0. The koodam build does
// not use it. Copy it as make_activation_test.go to src/lifecycle-core of a clean clone of the
// Entelos tag v0.7.0, and run it there:
//
//	FIXTURE=<koodam testdata/v0.7.0> OUT=<file> go test -run TestMakeActivation .
import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestMakeActivation(t *testing.T) {
	fixture, out := os.Getenv("FIXTURE"), os.Getenv("OUT")
	read := func(path string) []byte {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return raw
	}
	// The seed of the public test key "a" of the vectors of the tag.
	var vectors struct {
		Keys map[string]struct {
			KeyID string `json:"key_id"`
			Seed  string `json:"seed"`
		} `json:"keys"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(read("../protocol/signed/vectors/signed-cases.json"), &vectors); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	keyA := vectors.Keys["a"]
	signer, err := NewSigner(Encode(Object{"format": SigningKeyFormat, "algorithm": signatureAlgorithm,
		"key_id": keyA.KeyID, "seed": keyA.Seed}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot := must(Decode(read(filepath.Join(fixture, "snapshot-accept.record")))).(Object)
	signedDecision := must(Decode(read(filepath.Join(fixture, "decision-accept.signed.json")))).(Object)
	body, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(signedDecision["record"].(string))
	decision := must(Decode(body)).(Object)
	event := Object{"format": RecordFormat, "kind": "enable", "scope": decision["scope"], "function": decision["function"],
		"snapshot_ref": decision["snapshot_ref"], "report_ref": decision["report_ref"],
		"decision_ref": signedDecision["record_ref"], "from": decision["from"], "until": decision["until"],
		"actor": "activator-a", "targets": Array{ContentRef(Envelope(Media("target"), Encode(Object{"name": "fixture-target"})))}}
	eventRef := ContentRef(Envelope(Media("event"), Encode(event)))
	record := Encode(activationRecord(event, eventRef, snapshot, nil, Object{"runner": "fixture-runner"}, decision, ""))
	signed := signer.sign(snapshot["scope"].(string), snapshot["function"].(string), activationKind, record)
	signed["format"] = RecordFormat
	encoded := Encode(signed)
	keys, err := ParseKeySet(read(filepath.Join(fixture, "keyset.json")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := VerifyActivation(encoded, keys); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
